title: Spatial Entropy based Partitioning for Spatiotemporal Graph Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2608.29360v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spatiotemporal graphs underpin applications such as traffic forecasting, weather forecasting, and healthcare monitoring. Privacy regulations such as the GDPR and the CCPA require the complete removal of unauthorized data from trained models, but achieving this on a spatiotemporal graph is difficult: because information propagates globally through both spatial and temporal message passing, fully erasing a node's influence forces costly full-graph retraining. ST-graph unlearning requires both exactness and efficiency. We propose IsleNet, which uses spatial-entropy-guided partitioning to create balanced, locally coherent subgraphs and reconnects them with lightweight virtual edges. Upon an unlearning request, only the affected subgraph encoder and virtual-edge layer are retrained, ensuring exact removal with low cost. translated_title: 基于空间熵划分的时空图机器遗忘方法
translated_abstract: 时空图支撑着交通预测、天气预报和医疗监测等诸多应用。GDPR（通用数据保护条例）和CCPA（加州消费者隐私法案）等隐私法规要求从训练好的模型中完全删除未授权数据，但在时空图上实现这一点非常困难：由于信息通过空间和时间消息传递进行全局传播，完全擦除某个节点的影响需要进行代价高昂的全图重训练。时空图遗忘需要同时满足精确性和高效性。我们提出了IsleNet，该方法利用空间熵引导的划分来创建平衡且局部连贯的子图，并通过轻量级虚拟边将它们重新连接。当收到遗忘请求时，只需重新训练受影响的子图编码器和虚拟边层，即可确保以低成本实现精确删除。在四个真实世界基准数据集上的实验表明，IsleNet达到了全图准确率高达94%的水平，同时显著降低了遗忘成本。
tldr: 提出IsleNet，通过空间熵引导的划分构建平衡且局部连贯的子图并用轻量级虚拟边重连，遗忘时仅需重训练受影响的子图编码器和虚拟边层，以低成本实现时空图上精确的机器遗忘，同时保持高达94%的全图准确率。
en_tdlr: IsleNet enables exact and efficient spatiotemporal graph unlearning by using spatial-entropy-guided partitioning with lightweight virtual edges, retraining only the affected subgraph encoder upon unlearning requests, achieving up to 94% of full-graph accuracy at low cost.
